section_header: REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Suspension (No.1 and No.2 Lower Suspension Arms)
ocr_text:
RA-64

REAR AXLE AND SUSPENSION — Rear Suspension
(No.1 and No.2 Lower Suspension Arms)

(d) Install a new nut, connect the No.1 lower suspension arm to the axle carrier.
Torque: 600 kg·cm (43 ft·lb, 59 N·m)

3. INSTALL REAR DRIVE SHAFT
(See page RA-21)

4. TORQUE LOWER SUSPENSION ARM MOUNTING BOLTS AND NUTS
(a) Remove the stands and bounce the vehicle to stabilize the suspension.

(b) Torque the mounting bolts and nuts with the vehicle weight on the suspension.
Torque:
Body × Suspension arms
1,880 kg·cm (136 ft·lb, 184 N·m)
Axle carrier × No.2 lower suspension arm
1,670 kg·cm (121 ft·lb, 164 N·m)

5. CHECK REAR WHEEL ALIGNMENT (See page RA-3)
